				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707001
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707001
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_bahamas = {
	856 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	856 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.0016 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 2 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahamas }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_bahamas = {
	856 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	856 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 856 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = BAH is_subject = no } }
			}
			856 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahamas = THIS }
						set_variable = { 856.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahamas = THIS }
					set_variable = { 856.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			856 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_bahamas > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_bahamas = 0 }
		856 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_eng_bahamas = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_bahamas = {
	856 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_funding_live }
			856 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_arms_live }
			856 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahamas_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_bahamas = {
	856 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_bahamas_856 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_bahamas
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahamas } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = BAH }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_bahamas
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					856 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					856 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					856 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					856 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707002
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = BAH
					856 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707002 amount = 856.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahamas occupied = BAH days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707002
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_bahamas
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = BAH }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_bahamas
			}
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.004 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 3 }

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_belize = {
	845 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	845 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 845 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = BLZ is_subject = no } }
			}
			845 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_belize = THIS }
						set_variable = { 845.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_belize = THIS }
					set_variable = { 845.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			845 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_belize > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_belize = 0 }
		845 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_belize = {
	845 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_funding_live }
			845 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_arms_live }
			845 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_belize_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_belize = {
	845 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_belize_845 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_belize
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_belize } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = BLZ }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_belize
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					845 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					845 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					845 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					845 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.2 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 25 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						845 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_detente }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 15 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
					}
					set_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707003
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = BLZ
					845 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707003 amount = 845.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_belize occupied = BLZ days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707003
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_belize
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = BLZ }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_belize
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_hong_kong = {
	595 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	595 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.008 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 4 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_hong_kong }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_hong_kong = {
	595 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	595 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 595 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = HKG is_subject = no } }
			}
			595 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_hong_kong = THIS }
						set_variable = { 595.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_hong_kong = THIS }
					set_variable = { 595.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			595 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_hong_kong > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_hong_kong_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_hong_kong_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_hong_kong_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_hong_kong_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_hong_kong_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_hong_kong_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_hong_kong = 0 }
		595 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_gibraltar = {
	19 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	19 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.002 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 5 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_gibraltar }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_gibraltar = {
	19 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	19 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 19 }
				OR = { is_owned_by = ENG NOT = { is_core_of = owner } }
			}
			19 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_gibraltar = THIS }
						set_variable = { 19.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_gibraltar = THIS }
					set_variable = { 19.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			19 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_gibraltar > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_gibraltar_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_gibraltar_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_gibraltar_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_gibraltar_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_gibraltar_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_gibraltar_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_gibraltar = 0 }
		19 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_eng_gibraltar = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_gibraltar = {
	19 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_gibraltar_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_gibraltar = {
	19 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_gibraltar_19 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					19 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					19 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					19 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					19 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.2 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 25 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						19 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_detente }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 15 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
					}
					set_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707005
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707005
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_set_eng_gibraltar_civil = {
	COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_gibraltar = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_gibraltar
			COLDWAR_COL_active_eng_gibraltar = yes
			19 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days < 1 } }
		}
		19 = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 180 }
		}
		COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_gibraltar = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_recalculate_budget = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_view = yes
	}
}

	COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_atlantic_dependencies = yes

		limit = {
			tag = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_atlantic_dependencies
			COLDWAR_COL_active_eng_atlantic_dependencies = yes
			21 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days < 1 } }
		}
		21 = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 180 }
		}
		COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_atlantic_dependencies = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_recalculate_budget = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_view = yes
	}
}

		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_atlantic_dependencies_political_live days = 180 }

		COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_atlantic_dependencies = yes

		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
	}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_pacific_south = {
	533 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	1225 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	533 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.004 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 7 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_pacific_south }
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_organised_movement
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_pacific_south = {
	533 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1225 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1225 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = SOL is_subject = no } }
			}
			533 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_pacific_south = THIS }
						set_variable = { 533.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_pacific_south = THIS }
					set_variable = { 533.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	533 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 533 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = SOL is_subject = no } }
			}
			533 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_pacific_south = THIS }
						set_variable = { 533.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_pacific_south = THIS }
					set_variable = { 533.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			533 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_pacific_south > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_pacific_south = 0 }
		533 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_eng_pacific_south = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_pacific_south = {
	533 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_funding_live }
			533 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_arms_live }
			533 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pacific_south_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_fiji = {
	535 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	535 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.003 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 9 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_fiji }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_fiji = {
	535 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	535 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 535 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = FIJ is_subject = no } }
			}
			535 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_fiji = THIS }
						set_variable = { 535.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_fiji = THIS }
					set_variable = { 535.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			535 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_fiji > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_fiji = 0 }
		535 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_eng_fiji = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_fiji = {
	535 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_funding_live }
			535 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_arms_live }
			535 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_fiji_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_fiji = {
	535 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_fiji_535 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_fiji
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_fiji } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = FIJ }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_fiji
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					535 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					535 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					535 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					535 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707009
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = FIJ
					535 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707009 amount = 535.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_fiji occupied = FIJ days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707009
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_fiji
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = FIJ }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_fiji
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_new_hebrides = {
	543 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	543 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.002 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 11 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_new_hebrides }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_new_hebrides = {
	543 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	543 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 543 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = VAN is_subject = no } }
			}
			543 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_new_hebrides = THIS }
						set_variable = { 543.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_new_hebrides = THIS }
					set_variable = { 543.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			543 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_new_hebrides > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_new_hebrides = 0 }
		543 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_eng_new_hebrides = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_new_hebrides = {
	543 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_funding_live }
			543 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_arms_live }
			543 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_new_hebrides_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_new_hebrides = {
	543 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_new_hebrides_543 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_new_hebrides
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_new_hebrides } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = VAN }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_new_hebrides
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					543 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					543 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					543 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					543 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707011
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = VAN
					543 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707011 amount = 543.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_new_hebrides occupied = VAN days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707011
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_new_hebrides
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = VAN }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_new_hebrides
			}
		}
	}
}

	1217 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1217 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1217 }
				OR = { is_owned_by = NZL NOT = { is_core_of = owner } }
			}
			1217 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_nzl_tokelau = THIS }
						set_variable = { 1217.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_nzl_tokelau = THIS }
					set_variable = { 1217.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			1217 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_nzl_tokelau > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_tokelau_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_tokelau_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_tokelau_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_tokelau_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_tokelau_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_tokelau_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_nzl_tokelau = 0 }
		1217 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }

			if = {
				limit = {
					1217 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1217 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1217 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1217 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707012
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707012
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_nzl_cook_islands = {
	1220 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	1220 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.0008 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 13 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_nzl_cook_islands }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_nzl_cook_islands = {
	1220 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1220 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1220 }
				OR = { is_owned_by = NZL NOT = { is_core_of = owner } }
			}
			1220 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_nzl_cook_islands = THIS }
						set_variable = { 1220.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_nzl_cook_islands = THIS }
					set_variable = { 1220.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			1220 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_nzl_cook_islands > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_cook_islands_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_cook_islands_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_cook_islands_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_cook_islands_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_cook_islands_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_cook_islands_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_nzl_cook_islands = 0 }
		1220 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_nzl_cook_islands = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_nzl_cook_islands = {
	1220 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_cook_islands_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_overseas_territories = THIS }
					set_variable = { 69.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }

					}

			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_overseas_territories_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_overseas_territories_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_overseas_territories_arms_live } }

		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_fra_overseas_territories = 0 }
		69 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_fra_overseas_territories = {
	69 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing

				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_overseas_territories_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_overseas_territories_arms days = 180 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_overseas_territories_arms_live days = 180 }
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_fra_overseas_territories = 1 }
		COLDWAR_COL_disclose_arms = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_fra_overseas_territories = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_apply_fra_overseas_territories = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_fra_comoros = {
	269 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	940 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	1214 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	269 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.004 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 15 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros }
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_organised_movement
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_fra_comoros = {
	269 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1214 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1214 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = COM is_subject = no } }
			}
			269 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros = THIS }
						set_variable = { 269.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros = THIS }
					set_variable = { 269.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	940 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 940 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = COM is_subject = no } }
			}
			269 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros = THIS }
						set_variable = { 269.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros = THIS }
					set_variable = { 269.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	269 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 269 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = COM is_subject = no } }
			}
			269 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros = THIS }
						set_variable = { 269.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros = THIS }
					set_variable = { 269.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			269 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_fra_comoros > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_fra_comoros = 0 }
		269 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_fra_comoros = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_fra_comoros = {
	269 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_funding_live }
			269 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_arms_live }
			269 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_comoros_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_fra_comoros
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					269 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					269 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }

				}

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.2 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 25 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						269 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_detente }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 15 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
					}
					set_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707015
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = COM

				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707015 amount = 269.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros occupied = COM days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {

			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }

	COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_fra_comoros = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			tag = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_comoros
			COLDWAR_COL_active_fra_comoros = yes
			269 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days < 1 } }
		}
		269 = {
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 180 }
		}
		COLDWAR_COL_apply_fra_comoros = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_recalculate_budget = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_view = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_fra_french_somaliland = {
	230 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	1020 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	230 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.006 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 16 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_french_somaliland }
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_organised_movement
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_fra_french_somaliland = {
	230 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1020 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1020 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = DJI is_subject = no } }
			}
			230 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_french_somaliland = THIS }
						set_variable = { 230.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_french_somaliland = THIS }
					set_variable = { 230.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	230 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 230 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = DJI is_subject = no } }
			}
			230 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_french_somaliland = THIS }
						set_variable = { 230.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_french_somaliland = THIS }
					set_variable = { 230.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			230 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_fra_french_somaliland > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_fra_french_somaliland = 0 }
		230 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_fra_french_somaliland = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_fra_french_somaliland = {
	230 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_funding_live }
			230 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_arms_live }
			230 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_fra_french_somaliland_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_fra_french_somaliland = {
	230 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_fra_french_somaliland_230 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_fra_french_somaliland
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_french_somaliland } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = DJI }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_fra_french_somaliland
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					230 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					230 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					230 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					230 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.2 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 25 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						230 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_detente }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 15 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
					}
					set_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707016
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = DJI
					230 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707016 amount = 230.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_french_somaliland occupied = DJI days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707016
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_fra_french_somaliland
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = DJI }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_fra_french_somaliland
			}
		}
	}
	1020 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_fra_french_somaliland_1020 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_fra_french_somaliland
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_fra_french_somaliland } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = DJI }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_fra_french_somaliland
			}
			if = {

				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					230 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_por_angola = {
	296 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_angola_funding_live }
			296 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_angola_arms_live }
			296 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_angola_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_por_angola = {
	296 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_por_angola_296 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_angola
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_angola } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = AGL }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_angola
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					296 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					296 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					296 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					296 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.3 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 35 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						296 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_detente }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 15 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
					}
					set_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707018
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = AGL
					296 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707018 amount = 296.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_angola occupied = AGL days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707018
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_angola
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = AGL }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_angola
			}
		}
	}
	297 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_por_angola_297 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {

					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707018
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = AGL
					296 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707018 amount = 296.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_angola occupied = AGL days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707018
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_angola
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = AGL }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_angola
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_por_mozambique = {
	261 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_mozambique_funding_live }
			261 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_mozambique_arms_live }
			261 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_mozambique_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_por_mozambique = {
	261 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_por_mozambique_261 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_mozambique
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_mozambique } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = MOZ }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_mozambique
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					261 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					261 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }

	}

		else = {

			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 20 }

			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_organised_movement
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_por_guinea_bissau = {
	361 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1003 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1003 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = GUB is_subject = no } }
			}
			361 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_guinea_bissau = THIS }
						set_variable = { 361.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_guinea_bissau = THIS }
					set_variable = { 361.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	361 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 361 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = GUB is_subject = no } }
			}
			361 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_guinea_bissau = THIS }
						set_variable = { 361.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_guinea_bissau = THIS }
					set_variable = { 361.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			361 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_por_guinea_bissau > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_guinea_bissau_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_guinea_bissau_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_guinea_bissau_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_guinea_bissau_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_guinea_bissau_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_guinea_bissau_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_por_guinea_bissau = 0 }
		361 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707020
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = GUB
					361 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707020 amount = 361.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_guinea_bissau occupied = GUB days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707020
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_guinea_bissau
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = GUB }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_guinea_bissau
			}
		}
	}
	1003 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_por_guinea_bissau_1003 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_guinea_bissau
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_guinea_bissau } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = GUB }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_guinea_bissau
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					361 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					361 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					361 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					361 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.3 }
				set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 35 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						361 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_detente }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 15 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
					}
					set_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707020
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = GUB
					361 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707020 amount = 361.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_guinea_bissau occupied = GUB days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707020
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_guinea_bissau

				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_guinea_bissau
			}
		}
	}
