COLDWAR_COL_initialize_hol_suriname = {
	878 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	1006 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	878 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.004 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 21 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_suriname }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_hol_suriname = {
	878 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1006 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1006 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = SUR is_subject = no } }
			}
			878 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_suriname = THIS }
						set_variable = { 878.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_suriname = THIS }
					set_variable = { 878.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	878 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 878 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = SUR is_subject = no } }
			}
			878 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_suriname = THIS }
						set_variable = { 878.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_suriname = THIS }
					set_variable = { 878.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			878 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_hol_suriname > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_hol_suriname = 0 }
		878 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_hol_suriname = {
	878 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_funding_live }
			878 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_arms_live }
			878 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_suriname_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					878 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					878 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707021
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = SUR
					878 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707021 amount = 878.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_suriname occupied = SUR days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707021
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_hol_suriname
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = SUR }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_hol_suriname
			}
		}
	}
}

		COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_hol_suriname = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_apply_hol_suriname = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
	}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_hol_netherlands_antilles = {
	49 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	49 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.002 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 22 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_netherlands_antilles }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_hol_netherlands_antilles = {
	49 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	49 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 49 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = NLA is_subject = no } }
			}
			49 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_netherlands_antilles = THIS }
						set_variable = { 49.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_netherlands_antilles = THIS }
					set_variable = { 49.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			49 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_hol_netherlands_antilles > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_hol_netherlands_antilles = 0 }
		49 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_hol_netherlands_antilles = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_hol_netherlands_antilles = {
	49 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_funding_live }
			49 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_arms_live }
			49 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_hol_netherlands_antilles_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_hol_netherlands_antilles = {
	49 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_hol_netherlands_antilles_49 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_hol_netherlands_antilles
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_netherlands_antilles } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = NLA }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_hol_netherlands_antilles
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					49 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					49 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					49 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					49 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707022
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = NLA
					49 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707022 amount = 49.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_hol_netherlands_antilles occupied = NLA days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707022
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_hol_netherlands_antilles
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = NLA }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_hol_netherlands_antilles
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_usa_trust_pacific = {
	819 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	821 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 821 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = MIC is_subject = no } }
			}
			819 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_trust_pacific = THIS }
						set_variable = { 819.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_trust_pacific = THIS }
					set_variable = { 819.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	820 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 820 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = MAR is_subject = no } }
			}
			819 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_trust_pacific = THIS }
						set_variable = { 819.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_trust_pacific = THIS }
					set_variable = { 819.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	819 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 819 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = PAU is_subject = no } }
			}
			819 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_trust_pacific = THIS }
						set_variable = { 819.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_trust_pacific = THIS }
					set_variable = { 819.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			819 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_usa_trust_pacific > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_trust_pacific_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_trust_pacific_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_trust_pacific_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_trust_pacific_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_trust_pacific_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_trust_pacific_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_usa_trust_pacific = 0 }
		819 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_usa_guam_marianas = {

				OR = { is_owned_by = USA NOT = { is_core_of = owner } }
			}

				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_guam_marianas = THIS }
						set_variable = { 818.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_guam_marianas = THIS }
					set_variable = { 818.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			818 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_usa_guam_marianas > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_guam_marianas_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_guam_marianas_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_guam_marianas_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_guam_marianas_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_guam_marianas_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_guam_marianas_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_usa_guam_marianas = 0 }
		818 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_usa_guam_marianas = {
	818 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_usa_guam_marianas_818 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					818 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					818 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					818 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					818 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707024
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707024
		}
	}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_usa_american_samoa = {
	826 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	826 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.0004 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 25 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_american_samoa }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_usa_american_samoa = {
	826 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	826 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 826 }
				OR = { is_owned_by = USA NOT = { is_core_of = owner } }
			}
			826 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_american_samoa = THIS }
						set_variable = { 826.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_american_samoa = THIS }
					set_variable = { 826.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			826 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_usa_american_samoa > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_american_samoa_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_american_samoa_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_american_samoa_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_american_samoa_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_american_samoa_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_american_samoa_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_usa_american_samoa = 0 }
		826 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.001 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 26 }

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_usa_virgin_islands = {
	1212 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1212 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1212 }
				OR = { is_owned_by = USA NOT = { is_core_of = owner } }
			}
			1212 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_virgin_islands = THIS }
						set_variable = { 1212.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_usa_virgin_islands = THIS }
					set_variable = { 1212.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			1212 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_usa_virgin_islands > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_virgin_islands_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_virgin_islands_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_virgin_islands_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_virgin_islands_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_virgin_islands_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_virgin_islands_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_usa_virgin_islands = 0 }
		1212 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_usa_virgin_islands = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_usa_virgin_islands = {
	1212 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_usa_virgin_islands_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_usa_virgin_islands = {
	1212 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_usa_virgin_islands_1212 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					1212 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1212 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1212 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1212 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707026
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707026
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_ast_png = {
	733 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	941 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	733 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.008 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 28 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_ast_png }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_ast_png = {
	733 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	941 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 941 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = PAP is_subject = no } }
			}
			733 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_ast_png = THIS }
						set_variable = { 733.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_ast_png = THIS }
					set_variable = { 733.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	733 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 733 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = PAP is_subject = no } }
			}
			733 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_ast_png = THIS }
						set_variable = { 733.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_ast_png = THIS }
					set_variable = { 733.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			733 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_ast_png > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_ast_png = 0 }
		733 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_ast_png = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_ast_png = {
	733 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_funding_live }
			733 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_arms_live }
			733 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_ast_png_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_ast_png = {
	733 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_ast_png_733 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_ast_png
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_ast_png } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = PAP }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_ast_png
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					733 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					733 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					733 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					733 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707028
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = PAP
					733 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707028 amount = 733.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_ast_png occupied = PAP days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707028
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_ast_png
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = PAP }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_ast_png
			}
		}
	}
	941 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_ast_png_941 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_ast_png
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_ast_png } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = PAP }

			}

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }

				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.012 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 29 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_saf_namibia }
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_organised_movement
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_saf_namibia = {
	282 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	283 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 283 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = NAM is_subject = no } }
			}
			282 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_saf_namibia = THIS }
						set_variable = { 282.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_saf_namibia = THIS }
					set_variable = { 282.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	282 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 282 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = NAM is_subject = no } }
			}
			282 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_saf_namibia = THIS }
						set_variable = { 282.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_saf_namibia = THIS }
					set_variable = { 282.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			282 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_saf_namibia > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_saf_namibia = 0 }
		282 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_saf_namibia = {
	282 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_saf_namibia_282 = yes
				is_core_of = NAM
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_seeded }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = no
				}
				set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_saf_namibia
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_saf_namibia }

				limit = {
					occupied_country_tag = NAM
				}
				set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_seeded
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < 30
					}
					set_resistance = 30
				}
			}
		}
	}
	283 = {

			limit = {

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_saf_namibia }
				force_enable_resistance = { occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_saf_namibia }
				start_resistance = NAM
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					occupied_country_tag = NAM
				}
				set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_seeded

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_saf_namibia = {
	282 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_funding_live }
			282 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_arms_live }
			282 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_saf_namibia_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {

				}

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }

					limit = {
						282 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_detente }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 15 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
					}
					set_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {

					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707029
			if = {

				}

			}
		}

			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707029

				}

				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_saf_namibia
			}

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.008 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 30 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_spr_western_sahara }
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_organised_movement
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_spr_western_sahara = {
	372 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	373 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 373 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = SHA is_subject = no } }
			}
			372 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_spr_western_sahara = THIS }
						set_variable = { 372.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_spr_western_sahara = THIS }
					set_variable = { 372.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	372 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 372 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = SHA is_subject = no } }
			}
			372 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_spr_western_sahara = THIS }
						set_variable = { 372.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_spr_western_sahara = THIS }
					set_variable = { 372.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			372 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_spr_western_sahara > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_spr_western_sahara = 0 }
		372 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_spr_western_sahara = {
	372 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_funding_live }
			372 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_arms_live }
			372 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_spr_western_sahara_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

					limit = {
						372 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_detente }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor = 15 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance < COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
					}
					set_resistance = COLDWAR_COL_resistance_floor
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {

			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_greenland_arms_live
		}

		1 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_den_greenland = {
	1 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_greenland_funding_live }
			1 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_greenland_arms_live }
			1 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_greenland_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

	}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_den_faroe = {
	2 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	2 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.0004 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 32 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_den_faroe }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_den_faroe = {
	2 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	2 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 2 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = FAO is_subject = no } }
			}
			2 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_den_faroe = THIS }
						set_variable = { 2.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_den_faroe = THIS }
					set_variable = { 2.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			2 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_den_faroe > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_den_faroe = 0 }
		2 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_den_faroe = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_den_faroe = {
	2 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_funding_live }
			2 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_arms_live }
			2 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_den_faroe_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_den_faroe = {
	2 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_den_faroe_2 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_den_faroe
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_den_faroe } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = FAO }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_den_faroe
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					2 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					2 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					2 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					2 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707032
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = FAO
					2 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707032 amount = 2.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_den_faroe occupied = FAO days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707032
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_den_faroe
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = FAO }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_den_faroe
			}
		}
	}
}

				owner = { controls_state = 752 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = BRU is_subject = no } }
				owner = { tag = BRU is_subject = yes }
			}
			752 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_brunei_protection = THIS }
						set_variable = { 752.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }

				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_brunei_protection = THIS }
					set_variable = { 752.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			752 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }

		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_brunei_protection_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_brunei_protection_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_brunei_protection_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_brunei_protection_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_brunei_protection_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_brunei_protection_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_brunei_protection = 0 }
		752 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					752 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					752 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707033
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = BRU
					752 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707033 amount = 752.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_brunei_protection occupied = BRU days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707033
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_brunei_protection
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = BRU }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_brunei_protection
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_bahrain_protection = {
	423 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	423 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.002 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 34 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahrain_protection }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_bahrain_protection = {
	423 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	423 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 423 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = BHR is_subject = no } }
				owner = { tag = BHR is_subject = yes }
			}
			423 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahrain_protection = THIS }
						set_variable = { 423.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahrain_protection = THIS }
					set_variable = { 423.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			423 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_bahrain_protection > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_bahrain_protection = 0 }
		423 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_eng_bahrain_protection = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_bahrain_protection = {
	423 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_funding_live }
			423 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_arms_live }
			423 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_bahrain_protection = {
	423 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_bahrain_protection_423 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_bahrain_protection
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahrain_protection } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = BHR }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_bahrain_protection
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					423 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					423 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					423 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					423 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707034
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = BHR
					423 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707034 amount = 423.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_bahrain_protection occupied = BHR days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707034
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_bahrain_protection
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = BHR }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_bahrain_protection
			}
		}
	}
}

		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_arms days = 180 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_bahrain_protection_arms_live days = 180 }
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_bahrain_protection = 1 }
		COLDWAR_COL_disclose_arms = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_bahrain_protection = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_bahrain_protection = yes
		COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_qatar_protection = {
	181 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	181 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.002 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 35 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_qatar_protection }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_qatar_protection = {
	181 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	181 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 181 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = QAT is_subject = no } }
				owner = { tag = QAT is_subject = yes }
			}
			181 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_qatar_protection = THIS }
						set_variable = { 181.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_qatar_protection = THIS }
					set_variable = { 181.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			181 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_qatar_protection > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_qatar_protection = 0 }
		181 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_eng_qatar_protection = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_qatar_protection = {
	181 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_funding_live }
			181 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_arms_live }
			181 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_qatar_protection_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_qatar_protection = {
	181 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_qatar_protection_181 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_qatar_protection
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_qatar_protection } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = QAT }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_qatar_protection
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					181 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					181 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					181 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					181 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707035
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = QAT
					181 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707035 amount = 181.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_qatar_protection occupied = QAT days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707035
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_qatar_protection
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = QAT }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_qatar_protection
			}
		}
	}
}

			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707036
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_trucial_states_protection
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = UAE }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_trucial_states_protection
			}
		}
	}
	180 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_trucial_states_protection_180 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_trucial_states_protection
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_trucial_states_protection } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = UAE }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_trucial_states_protection
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					179 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					179 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					179 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					179 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707036
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = UAE
					179 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707036 amount = 179.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_trucial_states_protection occupied = UAE days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707036
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_trucial_states_protection
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = UAE }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_trucial_states_protection
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_por_cape_verde = {
	398 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	398 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.002 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 37 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_cape_verde }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_por_cape_verde = {
	398 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	398 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 398 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = VER is_subject = no } }
			}
			398 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_cape_verde = THIS }
						set_variable = { 398.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_cape_verde = THIS }
					set_variable = { 398.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			398 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_por_cape_verde > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_por_cape_verde = 0 }
		398 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_por_cape_verde = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_por_cape_verde = {
	398 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_funding_live }
			398 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_arms_live }
			398 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_cape_verde_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}
