COLDWAR_COL_initialize_por_sao_tome = {
	320 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	320 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.001 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 38 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_sao_tome }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_por_sao_tome = {
	320 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	320 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 320 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = SAO is_subject = no } }
			}
			320 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_sao_tome = THIS }
						set_variable = { 320.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_sao_tome = THIS }
					set_variable = { 320.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			320 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_por_sao_tome > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_por_sao_tome = 0 }
		320 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_por_sao_tome = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_por_sao_tome = {
	320 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_funding_live }
			320 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_arms_live }
			320 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_sao_tome_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_por_sao_tome = {
	320 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_por_sao_tome_320 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_sao_tome
					NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_forced_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_sao_tome } }
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = SAO }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_sao_tome
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					320 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					320 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					320 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					320 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707038
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = SAO
					320 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707038 amount = 320.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_sao_tome occupied = SAO days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707038
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_sao_tome
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = SAO }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_sao_tome
			}
		}
	}
}

				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707039
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = MAC
					1106 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707039 amount = 1106.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_macau occupied = MAC days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707039
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_macau
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = MAC }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_por_macau
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_por_timor = {
	734 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	1226 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	734 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.002 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 40 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_timor }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_por_timor = {
	734 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1226 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1226 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = TIM is_subject = no } }
			}
			734 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_timor = THIS }
						set_variable = { 734.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_timor = THIS }
					set_variable = { 734.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	734 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 734 }
				NOT = { owner = { tag = TIM is_subject = no } }
			}
			734 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_timor = THIS }
						set_variable = { 734.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_por_timor = THIS }
					set_variable = { 734.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			734 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_por_timor > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_por_timor = 0 }
		734 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_por_timor = {
	734 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_funding_live }
			734 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_arms_live }
			734 = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 5 } }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_por_timor_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_eng_pitcairn = {
	18 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	18 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.0004 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 41 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_pitcairn }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_eng_pitcairn = {
	18 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	18 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 18 }
				OR = { is_owned_by = ENG NOT = { is_core_of = owner } }
			}
			18 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_pitcairn = THIS }
						set_variable = { 18.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_pitcairn = THIS }
					set_variable = { 18.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			18 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_pitcairn > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pitcairn_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pitcairn_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pitcairn_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pitcairn_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pitcairn_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pitcairn_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_eng_pitcairn = 0 }
		18 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_eng_pitcairn = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_eng_pitcairn = {
	18 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_eng_pitcairn_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_eng_pitcairn = {
	18 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_eng_pitcairn_18 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					18 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					18 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					18 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					18 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707041
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707041
		}
	}
}

					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707042
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
					occupied_country_tag = TON
					1115 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus > 0 } }
				}
				add_resistance_target = { id = 19707042 amount = 1115.COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus occupier = var:global.COLDWAR_COL_power_eng_tonga_protection occupied = TON days = 2 tooltip = COLDWAR_COL_foreign_target_tt }
			}
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707042
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_tonga_protection
				}
				force_disable_resistance = { clear = yes occupier = var:COLDWAR_COL_forced_power occupied = TON }
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_forced_eng_tonga_protection
			}
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_initialize_nzl_niue = {
	1218 = { set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_registered }
	1218 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_initialized
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy_days = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_issue_serial = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_weekly_cost = 0.0004 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_index = 43 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_power = global.COLDWAR_COL_power_nzl_niue }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_reconcile_nzl_niue = {
	1218 = {
		set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
	}
	1218 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = { controls_state = 1218 }
				OR = { is_owned_by = NZL NOT = { is_core_of = owner } }
			}
			1218 = {
				clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive
			}
			owner = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_subject = yes
					}
					overlord = {
						set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_nzl_niue = THIS }
						set_variable = { 1218.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_power_nzl_niue = THIS }
					set_variable = { 1218.COLDWAR_COL_power = THIS }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			1218 = { has_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_inactive }
			check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_nzl_niue > 0 }
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_niue_political_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_niue_funding_live has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_niue_arms_live } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_niue_political_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_niue_funding_live
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_niue_arms_live
		}
		set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_COL_has_live_aid_nzl_niue = 0 }
		1218 = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 } clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing }
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_seed_nzl_niue = {
	# Quiet and associated administrations do not create armed conflicts.
}

COLDWAR_COL_sum_support_nzl_niue = {
	1218 = {
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_COL_support_bonus min = 0 max = 15 }
		clr_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_nzl_niue_political_live }
			}
			set_state_flag = COLDWAR_COL_political_backing
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_COL_apply_nzl_niue = {
	1218 = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_state_nzl_niue_1218 = yes
			}
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					1218 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1218 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1218 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					1218 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707043
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707043
		}
	}
}

			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0 }
			set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					441 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 0 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.005 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0.02 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					441 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 1 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = 0.08 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = 0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.015 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					441 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 2 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.15 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.1 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.03 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = -0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = -0.01 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					441 = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_policy = 3 } }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.05 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.18 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_target = -0.06 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_compliance_growth = 0.02 }
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resistance_growth = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_resistance = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 19
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_construction = -0.10 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 39
					}
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_resources = -0.10 }
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_garrison = 0.15 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						resistance > 59
					}
					set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_supply = -0.10 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			}
			remove_resistance_target = 19707044
		}
		else = {
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_administration }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_petition_unanswered }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_services_grant }
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_COL_public_consultation }
			remove_resistance_target = 19707044
		}
	}

COLDWAR_COL_select_next = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected > 44 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected < 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected = 44 }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		end = 44
		if = {
			limit = {
				COLDWAR_COL_own_selected = no
			}
			add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected > 44 }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected < 1 }
				}
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_selected = 44 }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_COL_refresh_view = yes
}
